evaluation_policy.opponents: same exact current-meta package family frozen for CR-013/CR-014 unless a package becomes unavailable; any replacement must be recorded before candidate execution
evaluation_policy.stage_a: Run the eventual CR-015 candidate only after its rule is frozen from CR-014. Compare paired terminal money delta and W/L against both frozen controls on all Stage A tuples. R4B-only results may select a close-boundary subset; candidate outcomes may not select tuples.
evaluation_policy.stage_b: May run only if Stage A supports the direction of the frozen refinement. No thresholds or code changes are allowed between Stage A and Stage B.
evaluation_policy.failure_rule: A refinement that improves mean money while creating a net increase in unfavorable W/L flips is rejected. Outcome conversion has priority over margin optimization.

purpose: Independent fresh evaluation distribution for the next identity-free CR-011 refinement, preregistered before CR-014 context-attribution results are known.
